about: TASKS.csv #493 - an independent minimum-curvature reference: 20 GSWA drillholes (the most curved ones surveyed from the collar) with baselode's precomputed desurvey positions, as offsets from the collar (metres; x = grid east, y = grid north, z = up) at each survey station. Survey rows: [depth m, azimuth deg (grid, MGA zone 50), dip deg (negative = down)].
source: Geological Survey of Western Australia, GSWA Geochemistry (DMIRS-047), sample CSVs as distributed in github.com/darkmine-oss/baselode (test/data/gswa), positions from its demo_gswa_precomputed_desurveyed.csv (minimum curvature). Subset and reshaped for this test.
